experiment.name: legacy_graphsage_exp3
experiment.description: The Experiment 3 architecture and its 167-column representation, run under the same protocol as every other candidate. A benchmark of the architecture, NOT a restatement of the frozen checkpoint's historical result.

dataset.name: reference_dkdata
dataset.label_definition: positive = graph node attribute 'core' is True, set by Layer 3 from the payer_core / beneficiary_core flags carried by the source records; it marks entities named as core to the published investigation, not a supervised fraud adjudication
notes: Version is derived from file size and mtime, not a content hash.
The positive class is extremely rare; see the split plan's notes for which folds can support label-dependent metrics.
